name: Arctic Monkeys

whyMatters.en: Sheffield band that rose via mid-2000s online demos then Whatever People Say I Am (2006); later records shifted toward slower, R&B-tinged rock without lineup break.
whyMatters.zh: 谢菲尔德乐队：经 2000 年代中期网络 demo 再到 Whatever People Say I Am（2006）；后期专辑转向更慢、偏 R&B 的摇滚且阵容未裂。

shortBio.en: Turner-led indie/alt; Dancefloor and Do I Wanna Know? mark early and mid eras.
shortBio.zh: Turner 领衔的 indie/alt；Dancefloor 与 Do I Wanna Know? 标记早期与中期。

body.en:
Formed 2002. Debut album set rapid indie-punk diction and Helders’s drums; Favourite Worst Nightmare kept speed; AM (2013) slowed grooves and added falsetto hooks for global rock radio.

I Bet You Look Good on the Dancefloor (2005) and Do I Wanna Know? (2013) are the era poles. Online word-of-mouth is part of the distribution history.
body.zh:
2002 年组建。首专定下快速 indie-punk 吐字与 Helders 鼓；Favourite Worst Nightmare 保持速度；AM（2013）放慢 groove 并加入假声钩子打进全球摇滚电台。

I Bet You Look Good on the Dancefloor（2005）与 Do I Wanna Know?（2013）是时代两极。网络口碑属分发史的一部分。

title.en: UK indie speed, then deliberate slowdown
title.zh: 英国 indie 速度，然后有意减速

body.en:
Arctic Monkeys matter as a two-gear catalog: early Sheffield urgency, later polished mid-tempo rock. Same core four (with O’Malley replacing early bassist).

Internet-era debut logistics plus song craft.
body.zh:
Arctic Monkeys 要紧处是双档目录：早期谢菲尔德紧迫，后期抛光中速摇滚。核心四人大致稳定（O’Malley 替换早期贝斯）。

互联网时代出道后勤加歌曲工艺。

body.en:
Fast downstrokes, Turner’s syllable density, Helders fill—2005/06 UK indie chart weapon.

Live wire energy before the AM sheen.
body.zh:
快速下行扫弦、Turner 音节密度、Helders 加花——2005/06 英国 indie 榜武器。

AM 光泽之前的带电能量。

title.en: Do I Wanna Know?: riff at ballad tempo
title.zh: Do I Wanna Know?：谣曲速度的 riff

body.en:
Sticky guitar figure, roomy drums, falsetto hook—AM’s global radio object.

Proof the band can change tempo identity without changing logo.
body.zh:
黏着吉他音型、宽鼓组、假声钩子——AM 的全球电台对象。

证明乐队可改速度身份而不改 logo。

title.zh: 北方吐字，后期录音室光泽

body.en:
Early records foreground local detail in lyrics; later production borrows from US rock/R&B radio compression.

DNA is writing voice + willingness to retune the groove.
body.zh:
早期唱片突出歌词地方细节；后期制作借用美国摇滚/R&B 电台压缩。

DNA 是写作声线 + 愿意重调 groove。

title.en: Press lines about pace and fame
title.zh: 关于节奏与成名的媒体句子

body.en:

Useful as timeline markers beside the albums.

可作专辑旁的时间线标记。
